item.title: New Year's resolutions
item.description:
This new year has just started (well 27 days ago), but I have been thinking about what I would like to learn and change during this 2024. Here are my personal thoughts on the matter. I hope they could inspire you to do a similar list.

What I would like to learn

Tech

Domain Driven Design

Code bases I have worked on in my career tend to have some tech debt, and the code structure is very different depending on the developer that created the code. Do not know if true, but the promise of a common language not only between the product team and developers, but even among themselves, seems seductive.
